full_judgment:
"I am of the opinion that an Assistant Sessions Judge deemed to be appointed as Additional Sessions Judge under the proviso to sub-section (3) of section 9 is to be treated as Additional Sessions Judge for all purposes of the Code subject to the only limitation that his sentencing power does not extend to the imposition of the sentence of death but extend only to the imposition of sentence of transportation for life and he is competent to hear revisional application under section 439A(3) Cr. P.C. and appeals under section 409 Cr. P.C." 

 24. Let the memorandum of appeal be returned to the appellants. The appeal may now be filed before the Sessions Judge and there will be no question of limitation.
